sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "businesses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_footer" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "receipt_note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "use_order_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("use_order_status" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_seen_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "address" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "services" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_days" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), CHECK (kind IN ('kiloan', 'satuan')), CHECK (price >= 0), CHECK (duration_days >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "order_no" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "pay_term" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sekarang', "proposal_id" TEXT NULL, "discount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "entered_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "estimated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtotal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), CHECK (status IN ('menunggu_jemput', 'diproses', 'siap', 'selesai', 'dibatalkan')), CHECK (source IN ('kasir', 'whatsapp_ai')), CHECK (pay_term IN ('sekarang', 'cod')), CHECK (discount >= 0 AND subtotal >= 0 AND total >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "order_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id), "service_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES services (id), "service_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_price" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), CHECK (qty_milli >= 0 AND unit_price >= 0 AND line_total >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id), "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "received" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), CHECK (method IN ('tunai', 'qris', 'transfer', 'tabungan')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "savings_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES orders (id), "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), CHECK (kind IN ('setor', 'pakai', 'penyesuaian')), CHECK (method IN ('tunai', 'qris', 'transfer', 'tabungan')), CHECK (kind = 'penyesuaian' OR amount > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES expense_categories (id), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vendor" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "spent_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), CHECK (amount >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "paper_mm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 58, "font_size" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 11, "show_address" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_address" IN (0, 1)), "show_customer" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_customer" IN (0, 1)), "show_savings" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_savings" IN (0, 1)), "show_note" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_note" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), CHECK (paper_mm IN (58, 80)), CHECK (font_size > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entitlements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "plan" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free', "valid_until" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')), CHECK ("plan" IN ('free', 'pro')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "order_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders (id), "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "from_status" TEXT NULL, "to_status" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (sync_state IN ('synced', 'pending', 'conflict')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (op IN ('upsert', 'delete')), CHECK (attempts >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "string_value" TEXT NULL, "int_value" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"), CHECK ((string_value IS NOT NULL) != (int_value IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "last_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("table_name"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX devices_owner_code ON devices (owner_id, code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customers_active_phone ON customers (owner_id, phone) WHERE is_active = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND phone <> ''
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_owner_number ON orders (owner_id, order_no)
CREATE INDEX orders_entered ON orders (entered_at)
CREATE INDEX orders_status_entered ON orders (status, entered_at)
CREATE INDEX items_order ON order_items (order_id)
CREATE INDEX payments_order ON payments (order_id)
CREATE INDEX payments_paid ON payments (paid_at)
CREATE INDEX savings_customer_created ON savings_entries (customer_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX expenses_spent ON expenses (spent_at)
CREATE INDEX events_order_time ON order_events (order_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX outbox_created ON outbox (created_at)
